name: queue_event_effect_package_load

stack.evidence: func_001DF008 consumes two values, indexes the six-byte event-effect path-prefix table D_003D55E0 with the first, formats the second as _%03d, constructs paired eveffect/*.dpp and *.dpx paths, queues the DPP load with cdvd_QueueFileLoad, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: The handler allocates the package buffer, records package_id in ScriptRuntime.eventEffectPackageId at offset 0x3094, and sets the asynchronous event-effect load flag serviced by func_001DF198. Representative al09.ard copies pass prefix index 16 (gb/gb) and package ID 2, then call func_001DF198 through command 166 after an eight-tick delay.

relations.difference: Command 734 loads the paired package into memory slot 0x3C; command 165 uses slot 0x32.
